title: Разговор по душам в кабинете  (A Heart-to-Heart in the Office)

segments.t: Impressed by Max's work at the stove, Aleksandr invites him into the office for a mid-shift drink and asks where he learned to cook. After joking that Max should have dodged the army too, the new chef starts asking which women at Claude Monet are single.
Спасибо, шеф.
Ты где готовить учился?
О, в армии еще чему-то учат?
А ты не служил?
Но, между прочим, тебе тоже надо было сбежать.
У тебя есть потенциал?
Да, заходи.
Да я вообще-то на работе.
Да ладно, шеф разрешает.
Слушай, а расскажи мне о наших девушках.
Понял, девушка моего друга, мой враг.
А ладно, в хорошем смысле.
А вон та.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
Спасибо, шеф.
'Thank you, Chef.' Around the truth and plan, Barinov sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya.
Ты где готовить учился?
'Where did you learn to cook?' Here asking where Barinov learns to cook shows Kostya looking for the real truth. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
О, в армии еще чему-то учат?
'Oh, they still teach you something in the army?' With the work and conversation hanging in the air, Nastya puts Barinov on the spot.
А ты не служил?

'Wait, did you not serve?' Asking whether Kostya not serve cuts straight through the tension between Barinov and Kostya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Но, между прочим, тебе тоже надо было сбежать.

'By the way, you should have run away from the draft too.' Saying that Barinov should have run away from the draft is how Kostya sets the tone with Barinov. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
У тебя есть потенциал?
'Do you think I have potential?' Here checking whether Barinov thinks she has potential shows Nastya looking for the real truth.
Да, заходи.
'Yes, come on in.' With the office and work in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Да я вообще-то на работе.
'I am actually on the clock right now.' Even though he is actually on the clock right now, Kostya keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Да ладно, шеф разрешает.
'Come on, the Chef allows it.' By coming on the Chef allows it, Nastya keeps her side of the story grounded.
Слушай, а расскажи мне о наших девушках.
'Listen, tell me about our girls here.' Adding that Kostya should tell him about their girls here fills in the missing piece for Kostya.
Понял, девушка моего друга, мой враг.
'Got it, pal's girlfriend is off-limits.' Kostya explains that got it pal girlfriend is off limits, keeping his voice calm and direct.
А ладно, в хорошем смысле.
'All right, in the good sense.' Around the office and conversation, Nastya sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
А вон та.
